case.title: One Bell
case.author_invariant: stable-bell names one replaceable timer; deadline is always the latest pulse time plus five, so only the final timer of each maximal cluster can fire.

worked_value.note: A gap of five extends a cluster; a gap of six starts another.

story.premise: A platform vibration sensor chatters. Produce one stable bell per maximal pulse cluster, exactly five quiet ticks after its final pulse.
story.submission: Submit a canonical PULSE 0.1 program and, optionally, a short invariant note.
story.diagnostics: The verifier exhaustively checks every zero-to-seven-pulse subset of a twelve-tick horizon plus duplicate and boundary fixtures, returning the first counterexample.
hints: Remember the current deadline, not the pulse history.
Scheduling the same timer key replaces its older pending timer.
A pulse and a timer at the same tick process the external pulse first.
